subject: General Knowledge
topic: First Women of India — mixed tiers
description: First woman in various Indian fields: president, PM, IAS, IPS, judge, Everest, space, ministers

questions.stem: The first WOMAN PRESIDENT of India was:
questions.explanation: Pratibha Devisingh Patil — 12th President of India (2007-2012) — first woman to hold the office. Droupadi Murmu is the 15th President (2022–), first tribal-origin President and second woman. Indira Gandhi was a PM, never President. Sucheta Kripalani was India's first woman Chief Minister (UP, 1963-67).

questions.stem: The first Indian WOMAN in SPACE was:
questions.explanation: Kalpana Chawla — Indian-American astronaut — first Indian-born woman in space (STS-87, Columbia, November 1997). Died in Columbia disaster 1 February 2003. Sunita Williams (Indian-American) holds the record for total spacewalks by a woman.

questions.stem: The first WOMAN to climb Mount Everest was Japanese mountaineer Junko Tabei (1975). The first INDIAN woman to reach the summit was:
questions.explanation: Bachendri Pal — first Indian woman to summit Everest on 23 May 1984 as part of the 4th Indian Everest Expedition. Padma Shri 1984, Padma Bhushan 2019. Santosh Yadav was the first woman to summit Everest TWICE (1992, 1993). Arunima Sinha was the first FEMALE AMPUTEE to summit Everest (2013).

questions.stem: The first WOMAN IAS OFFICER of India was:
questions.explanation: Anna Rajam Malhotra — joined IAS in 1951 (Madras cadre). Kiran Bedi (1972) was the first woman IPS officer. M. Fathima Beevi was the first woman judge of the Supreme Court (1989).

questions.stem: Match the FIRST WOMAN with her achievement. A. Sarojini Naidu.  B. Indira Gandhi.  C. Justice M. Fathima Beevi.  D. Meera Kumar. List-II: 1. First woman Prime Minister. 2. First woman President of INC + first woman Governor. 3. First woman Speaker of Lok Sabha. 4. First woman judge of the Supreme Court.
questions.explanation: Sarojini Naidu — 'Nightingale of India' — president of INC (1925, Kanpur); first woman Governor (UP, 1947). Indira Gandhi — 1st woman PM, 1966. Justice Fathima Beevi — 1st woman SC judge, 1989. Meera Kumar — 1st woman Speaker of Lok Sabha, 2009.

questions.stem: The first INDIAN-ORIGIN woman to win the BOOKER PRIZE was:
questions.explanation: Arundhati Roy won the Booker Prize in 1997 for 'The God of Small Things'. Kiran Desai won it in 2006 for 'The Inheritance of Loss'. Jhumpa Lahiri won Pulitzer (not Booker). Geetanjali Shree won the International Booker in 2022 for 'Tomb of Sand' (originally in Hindi) — a translated-Hindi-work first.

questions.stem: The first WOMAN CHIEF MINISTER of an Indian state was:
questions.explanation: Sucheta Kripalani — CM of Uttar Pradesh (1963-1967) — first woman CM in India. Nandini Satpathy was Odisha CM (1972-76). Sheila Dikshit was Delhi CM (1998-2013).
